svg.title: Negima Mochi: which command uses what
svg.desc: /mochi:build → plan (when no plan file is given). /mochi:build → tidy (each slice). /mochi:build → commit (each slice and the review fixes). /mochi:build → /mochi:review (after the slices). /mochi:fix-bug → tidy (when the fix left duplication). /mochi:fix-bug → commit (the fix). plan → bar-raiser (once, plus one re-check). /mochi:pr → commit (when tracked files have uncommitted changes). /mochi:refactor → plan (one plan per group of picks). /mochi:refactor → tidy (its six checks, on the whole area). /mochi:refactor → correctness reviewer. /mochi:refactor → test reviewer. /mochi:refactor → hygiene reviewer. /mochi:refactor → data reviewer (when the area holds database access). /mochi:refactor → markup a11y reviewer (when the area holds markup and no stack plugin reviews its accessibility). /mochi:refactor → api contract reviewer (when the area is a FastAPI service with an HTTP surface). /mochi:refactor → conventions reviewer (when the area is a FastAPI service). /mochi:refactor → a11y reviewer (when the area is React + Fluent). /mochi:refactor → conventions reviewer (when the area is React + Fluent). /mochi:review → correctness reviewer. /mochi:review → test reviewer. /mochi:review → hygiene reviewer (scoped to comments and docs when the tidy skill already ran, as in build). /mochi:review → data reviewer (when an area touches database access). /mochi:review → markup a11y reviewer (when an area changes markup and no stack plugin reviews its accessibility). /mochi:review → api contract reviewer (when an area is a FastAPI service and touches its HTTP surface). /mochi:review → conventions reviewer (when an area is a FastAPI service). /mochi:review → a11y reviewer (when an area is React + Fluent). /mochi:review → conventions reviewer (when an area is React + Fluent). /mochi:setup-project → dependencies (when adding a dead-code tool). /mochi:split → plan (its plan format, challenge, and view). Install guard → dependencies (points the install at it). api contract reviewer → api-design. api contract reviewer → openapi. conventions reviewer → architecture. conventions reviewer → domain-model. conventions reviewer → service-layer. conventions reviewer → testing. conventions reviewer → persistence (when the service depends on SQLAlchemy). performance → dependencies (when adding the virtualizer package). /mochi:setup-project → every mochi-python convention (reads every convention). Python convention loader → every mochi-python convention (injects each one, up front or when its paths match). /mochi:setup-project → every mochi-react convention (reads every convention). conventions reviewer → every mochi-react convention (reads all seven). React convention loader → every mochi-react convention (injects each one, up front or when its paths match).
